scope: All 386 rarity 5/6 armor pieces in MHDB 2026-04-15 snapshot; exact per-piece transcendence slots, including Mizutsune and Akuma.
notes: Do not use a generic slot upgrade formula: exact tables include Mizutsune exceptions and caps.
MHDB defense.max is miscomputed by summing breakpoint increments without filling skipped levels: correct maximum is base + 2*(maxLevel-1).
Slots are exactly three entries including zero; remove trailing zeros only for display if desired.
Transcendence is available for high rank armor at HR100; low rank armor is not eligible.
